user_saw: The agent Skills panel showed “No skills found” when the query and an existing skill name used different Unicode forms of the same spelling.
summary: The fix applies NFC normalization to the lowercased query and skill search text before substring matching.
reasoning: The July 1, 2026 snapshot already lowercased both sides and compared them with `.includes()` without Unicode normalization. The later UI refactors and filter caching preserved that comparison. The offline history lookup failed at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the original filter shipped with the defect or an earlier change introduced it.
